task_instance: User says to the office assistant, 'idk, just organize my notes folder however you think, whatever, I don't care' (casual/shrug-like delegation). Per the skill, this should trigger a Tarot draw (12 Houses of the Zodiac spread) via `uv run --no-config {baseDir}/scripts/draw_cards.py` to inject real entropy before deciding how to organize the notes, followed by interpreting the JSON output using INTERPRETATION_GUIDE.md and applying it to the task.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire core mechanism is running a Python script (scripts/draw_cards.py) via `uv run` that uses Python's `secrets` module (Fisher-Yates shuffle with secrets.randbelow()) to produce cryptographically-random card draws, then reading the resulting JSON. The office-assistant runtime explicitly cannot run code, scripts, or shell commands of any kind. The skill's own 'Error Handling' section forbids working around this: 'Never fake entropy: If the script cannot run, do not simulate a draw using your own randomness. Tell the user the draw failed.' So there is no legitimate way to satisfy the skill's deliverable without code execution -- manually picking cards with pseudo-randomness (e.g. from web-fetched random.org output, or from my own 'random' choice) is explicitly the rationalization the skill tells the agent to reject, since it isn't the script's audited secrets-based entropy source. Separately, I confirmed the skill's own source tree at benchmark/ce_sources/trailofbits__skills__let-fate-decide/ contains only SKILL.md and LICENSE -- the scripts/, houses/, and cards/ directories/files the skill depends on (draw_cards.py, house and card meaning markdown files, INTERPRETATION_GUIDE.md, TECHNICAL_CONTEXT_LENSES.md) are not present at all, which would block the deliverable even if code execution were allowed.
evidence: Read the skill document at benchmark/ce_sources/trailofbits__skills__let-fate-decide/SKILL.md, which requires executing `uv run --no-config {baseDir}/scripts/draw_cards.py` (optionally with --content) to obtain the actual card draw JSON, then reading per-card and per-house markdown files to interpret it. Ran Glob over benchmark/ce_sources/trailofbits__skills__let-fate-decide/** and found only SKILL.md and LICENSE -- no scripts/, houses/, or cards/ directories exist to run or read from. The office-assistant runtime grants only text file read/write/edit and public web fetch/search; it explicitly cannot run code or scripts. Since the skill requires a real script execution for genuine entropy and explicitly disallows simulating/faking the draw, and since running a script is outside the granted toolset (missing_tool_in_runtime), the task could not be attempted, let alone achieved. No files were created for a fake deliverable, per the skill's own explicit prohibition on faking entropy.
